maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body:
It's a good introduction, but your comment doesn't say what listpacks are.

In the comment below your change introduces it: "a memory efficient data structure when they have a small number of entries, and the biggest entry does not exceed a given threshold".

Also further down for sets and sorted sets, the comments just say "memory efficient data structure" without saying that it's a listpack.

Please rewrite the complete text so it introduces the listpack concept at the top and explains what it

maintainer_comments.body:
